intro: Elettaria cardamomum, commonly known as cardamom, is a highly valued spice with numerous health benefits. It is rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds that can help reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. Regular consumption of cardamom may improve digestion, alleviate bloating, and support respiratory health by easing coughs and congestion. Additionally, its calming properties can reduce stress and promote better sleep, enhancing overall well-being and quality of everyday life.
